privilege_diagnosis.identity: svc_edged (the EDGED_DB_URL role) on database stayconnect_site
privilege_diagnosis.why_the_earlier_grant_appeared_not_to_wo: The earlier attempt issued TWO grants in one psql -c: the opener, and a second on iam_v2.p5_begin_controlled_operation(text). psql runs a multi-statement -c as a single implicit transaction, so the second statement failing on a signature that does not match rolled the first one back with it. The privilege was never actually granted at that moment, which is why edged still refused after the restart. Granting the opener alone succeeds, and the guard then passes.
privilege_diagnosis.minimum_granted: EXECUTE on iam_v2.begin_controlled_operation(text) only -- no table write, no schema create, no ownership, no membership
